issues.description: Field 'DD.weight' has inconsistent type annotations between the template and the solution. In the template repository (template_repository/dd.py) the DD dataclass declares 'weight: float' (line 46-47), whereas the solution repository (solution_repository/dd.py) declares 'weight: np.complex128' (line 46-47) and the implementation (ZERO_TERM, ONE_TERM and many operations) treats edge weights as complex numbers. This mismatch between a real (float) annotation in the template and a complex annotation/usage in the solution is likely to confuse students (and static type checkers) about the intended numeric type for DD edge weights and may cause type-hint or mypy issues when students implement or use DDs.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the type annotation of DD.weight in the template to a complex type (for example: 'weight: np.complex128') and ensure 'numpy as np' is imported where needed. Also make sure the predefined terminals (ZERO_TERM, ONE_TERM) and any related annotations in the template use complex values (e.g. np.complex128(0), np.complex128(1)) and update docstrings/comments to state that DD edge weights are complex. This preserves the educational intent while removing a misleading type hint.
